{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in the near term (first 10 days) due to price level lag, with a correction of approximately 0.4-0.6 on average",
    "True outcomes show steady upward momentum in the first 10 days that model fails to capture, with prices rising ~1.5 from start to finish vs model's flat 68.18-68.36 range",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0.67+ or 1.00) correlates with model undershooting true prices by 0.3-0.8, suggesting sentiment momentum isn't fully reflected in forecasts",
    "Middle term (days 11-20) shows model consistently below true values by 0.8-1.5, indicating the model misses the continued strength that materializes",
    "Far term (days 21-30) reveals model is dramatically too low, with divergence growing to 2-4 points as true prices continue accelerating while model plateaus or declines",
    "When sentiment is strong positive (1.00), model fails to capture the full magnitude of price increases, requiring an additional 0.3-0.5 multiplier on those forecast points",
    "Mean reversion bias exists in model as prices move away from historical ranges, but the true market exhibits more persistent trends than the model models" ]}
